messages.subject: lavPredict for selected observations
parts:
Hello,

I have calculated a CFA with ordinal indicators and one factor using the pairwise missing data approach and the WLSMV estimator. Now I want to calculate factor scores for observations with at least 3 non-missing values on the five ordinal indicators. The default of lavPredict seems to be to calculate scores for all of the observations used in the CFA. Of course I can do that and set the scores for the observations with less than 3 non missing values to missing, but I wonder whether it is possible to restrict the relevant observations for the calculation of the factor scores beforehand.

Thank you,
Mirko

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: lavPredict for selected observations
parts:
You could use the newdata argument, with a subset of your full data set, lets say you define a new variable that identifies which subjects you want to get factor scores from called "kept"

dat_sub <- subset(dat_full, kept == 1)
lavpredict(object, newdata = dat_sub)
